title: Perform final release review and gate decision
description: Review the complete PRD, task matrix, diff, automated gates, browser/accessibility, security, artifact, VPS, and recovery evidence and make a pass/block decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required task has either verified pass evidence or an explicit approved waiver/blocker
No critical/high security finding, unresolved release regression, missing required artifact asset, or failed required VPS gate remains
Final version/metadata/checksum/manifest and English/Persian docs agree
The final report states what was tested, what passed, what was not available, and the exact next action if blocked

steps.details: Validate `.agent/tasks.json` against every spec, acceptance criterion, step flag, dependency, and evidence file; reject optimistic pass flags.
Have a fresh reviewer inspect the final diff/PRD/specs/evidence for spec compliance, regressions, and unsupported claims.
Fix confirmed issues, add regression tests, rerun affected gates, and update evidence; do not waive security or VPS requirements without explicit owner approval.
Produce a concise final gate report with pass/block status and artifact digest/version; publish only if all required gates pass.

technicalNotes: This is the only task allowed to make the release decision. It must not mark the goal complete while a required gate is unknown.
